engineeringSkip.reason: Femtometre-scale robots that reprogram molecular bonds on command have no basis in known physics or chemistry, and there is no real research programme behind this 'programmable neutral matter' concept.

factCheck.reason: No machine can exist at the femtometre scale described — that is the size of an atomic nucleus, smaller than the atoms any device would have to be built from — so remotely commanding bots to lock and unlock molecular bonds to reshape matter on demand has no basis in known physics.
